title: The Evolution of Voice Assistants: From Cascades to Full-Duplex AI
overview: This video explores the technological evolution of voice AI assistants, from traditional cascade systems to modern full-duplex models. It compares OpenAI's GPT-4o and GPT Live with the open-source Moshi model from Kyutai, explaining how architectural choices like end-to-end processing and concurrent audio streams enable more natural, human-like conversations. The video also discusses practical trade-offs between cascade and end-to-end approaches, and the future challenges of miniaturization and robot integration.
key_topics: Cascade vs. end-to-end voice assistant architectures
Full-duplex vs. half-duplex communication in AI
Inner monologue and its role in speech-to-speech models
Tool calling and asynchronous background processing
Post-training challenges for natural conversation metrics
Comparison of OpenAI GPT Live, GPT-4o, and Kyutai's Moshi
